topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Maintaining LOS connectivity requires robust beamforming techniques that adapt to dynamic channel conditions and aircraft mobility. Precise control over signal direction (array factor) using narrow beamwidths mitigates Doppler spread, while advanced digital processing and specialized hardware are needed for real-time adaptation. Higher numbers of beams with smaller beamwidths can increase bandwidth per beam, but also contribute to increased interference due to SNR variations.  Accurate prediction of aircraft trajectories and maneuverability through sophisticated algorithms is crucial for dynamic adaptation.
reference_context: Aeronautical communications involve A2G, A2A, and A2S communication at airports, populated areas, and unpopulated areas. Accurate channel characteristics knowledge is vital for designing and assessing aeronautical communication protocols.  Dynamic beamforming schemes are essential due to non-stationary spatial channel properties in ELAA. Performance of beam space multiplexing needs further research.
